commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
90+7' Half-chance! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) plays a pass into the box, but Bart Verbruggen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+7' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+6' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+5' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+4' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alisson, who smothers the ball.

90+2' CHANCE! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Federico Chiesa. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.

90' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.

88' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Brighton.

88' Brighton are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
